title: An etale closed immersion is an open immersion
statement: Let $i:V\to U$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then $i$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Consequently the image $T=i(V)$ is an open and closed subset of $U$, and $i$ is an isomorphism of $V$ onto the open subscheme $(T,\mathcal O_U|_T)$ of $U$.
